ios.desc:
Dots Puzzle is a challenging and minimal dot to dot measure puzzle game with handcrafted levels and aesthetic design.

Reveal hand crafted picture and amazing story in each puzzle by connecting all pairs of dots that are separated by one or two target distances! Warning: some of the puzzle can be extreme hard.

Designed exclusively for the iOS devices and carefully crafted to let you explore imagination and learn amazing stories make you surprised.

Features
• 36 carefully handcrafted puzzles and amazing stories behind in 4 levels
• Minimal and aesthetic visual design
• Relaxing music and sound design
• Clean and intuitive user interface
• Exclusive for Apple Devices
• Game Center integration with Leaderboard & Achievements
• No ads, because this game is designed for Kids
• Free trial of first level, all other levels can be unlock with single in app purchase.
